tours.name: Create an Accrual Plan
tours.description: Learn how to start an accrual plan, which gives employees time off gradually as they work, and where its levels are added.

description_i18n.en_US: Learn how to start an accrual plan, which gives employees time off gradually as they work, and where its levels are added.

steps.title: Open Time Off
steps.description: Accrual plans are configured in the Time Off app.

description_i18n.en_US: Accrual plans are configured in the Time Off app.

steps.title: Configuration menu
steps.description: The Configuration menu holds the lists of master data used across the Time Off app, such as time off types, accrual plans, public holidays and mandatory days.

description_i18n.en_US: The Configuration menu holds the lists of master data used across the Time Off app, such as time off types, accrual plans, public holidays and mandatory days.

steps.title: Accrual Plans
steps.description: An accrual plan gives employees leave days progressively, for example one day per month, instead of all at once. Each plan has one or more levels that set the rate.

description_i18n.en_US: An accrual plan gives employees leave days progressively, for example one day per month, instead of all at once. Each plan has one or more levels that set the rate.

steps.title: New
steps.content: Click New to create a record.

content_i18n.en_US: Click New to create a record.

steps.description: The New button opens a blank form.

description_i18n.en_US: The New button opens a blank form.

steps.title: Name
steps.content: Type the name, then press Tab.

content_i18n.en_US: Type the name, then press Tab.

steps.description: Name the plan after the rule it follows, for example Monthly accrual. The name is chosen when you create an allocation.

description_i18n.en_US: Name the plan after the rule it follows, for example Monthly accrual. The name is chosen when you create an allocation.

steps.title: Save
steps.content: Click the save icon to keep the record.

content_i18n.en_US: Click the save icon to keep the record.

steps.description: Saving creates the plan. Its levels, which set how many days are earned and how often, are added on the same form.

description_i18n.en_US: Saving creates the plan. Its levels, which set how many days are earned and how often, are added on the same form.

steps.title: Saved
steps.content: The record is saved. Click its name in the breadcrumb to finish.

content_i18n.en_US: The record is saved. Click its name in the breadcrumb to finish.

steps.description: The breadcrumb shows where you are. Use it to go back to the list.

description_i18n.en_US: The breadcrumb shows where you are. Use it to go back to the list.
